svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 1,100 x 270 mm from 3 mm sheet; round the corners; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wall holes: six 7 mm holes, 105 mm above and below the middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the middle and 500 mm each side of it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pipe clip holes: two pairs of 5.5 mm holes, 500 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle, 55 mm above the middle, 24 mm apart up and down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the board goes on the gable wall below the enclosure, its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle 465 mm above the ground and below the enclosure's centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: six screws into wall plugs. The manifold's centre is 45 mm off it,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in two stand-off pipe clips; the valves hang from its tees, 5 mm clear.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board is level and flat on the wall.
